title: EPI-GRAPHICS: browser-based journal-style figures (NEJM look) for clinical and epidemiological research
description: Browser tool that builds publication-ready figures in the style of the New England Journal of Medicine: bar charts with comparison brackets, subgroup forest plots, curves with confidence intervals and number at risk, Kaplan-Meier curves from individual data, CONSORT flow diagrams, study-design schemas and stacked ordinal bars. Exports vector SVG and PNG/TIFF with embedded DPI at journal column widths. All drawing runs in the browser.
